-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/splitfix

go 1.27

-- lgo/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func step() (int, error) {
	return 42, nil
}

func gate() error {
	if step()? == 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("gate: %v", 1)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	gate()
}
-- shortcircuit/go.mod --
module example.com/shortcircuit

go 1.27

-- shortcircuit/main.lgo --
package main

func okStep() (bool, error) {
	return true, nil
}

func gate(flag bool) error {
	if flag && okStep()? {
		return nil
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	gate(true)
}

-- loopcondition/go.mod --
module example.com/loopcondition

go 1.27

-- loopcondition/main.lgo --
package main

func step() (int, error) {
	return 42, nil
}

func spin() error {
	for step()? > 100 {
		break
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	spin()
}
